title: Will removing a batch remove stickers already in my packs
question: Will removing a batch remove stickers already in my packs?
answer: Remove batch moves the batch to the trash, where it can be restored. Stickers already added to a pack stay in their packs. If this does not match what you see, send a screenshot in Help.
looks_like: Remove batch is available, and Removed batches appears under Earlier batches.
